audit.summary: Independent adversarial review confirmed that the legacy /answer handler is a direct authenticated 410 with no code-level SQL, queue, or model path. It also found that SCOR-00 has no passed isolated receipt because Docker storage prevents PostgreSQL initdb before migration, that its original consumption snapshot omitted sent keys and the cross-owner principal, and that the HTTP app shares the migration identity. The snapshot coverage is now corrected in source, but real low-privilege runtime-identity evidence remains blocked. Cloud recovery and logical-node quota findings remain open; releaseEvidence=false.

findings.disposition: Cloud target profile currently contains static instance/VPC declarations, certificate pin and artifact/case checks, but it has no signed TargetGrant or control-plane attestation that the writable target is the declared RDS instance/VPC. Docker retirement and destructive cloud execution remain blocked.

The local ledger now persists planned resource names before execution and fails closed on unproven ownership, but no real PostgreSQL proof has exercised transaction rollback, 20-way CAS, or crash boundaries from requested through each DDL and cleanup step.

A crash after CREATE and before OID ownership persistence must remain failed_cleanup with explicit operator evidence; the runner must never infer ownership or delete by name alone. This path lacks a real cloud recovery receipt.

Current app_role direct UPDATE can move a legacy claimed invocation to dispatching without a slot. Implementation remains blocked until a database BEFORE UPDATE fence or revoked direct UPDATE plus controlled procedure proves old workers cannot bypass the one-slot boundary.

The current durable invocation state has no known_not_sent value. The implementation must preserve failed plus deterministic pre-dispatch error as the durable state and reserve known_not_sent for its business projection, or explicitly migrate every state-machine consumer.

A slot created only at dispatch would permit a new idempotency key after an earlier pre-dispatch terminal. The implementation requires a server-derived canonical header per business revision before it can claim a complete logical-node cap.
Tests must distinguish one valid dispatch exactly once from each rejected path at zero; a generic zero-or-one assertion is insufficient.
The initial binding inventory must explicitly cover planning, question generation, evaluation including quote repair, quiz, diagnosis, and report before it can claim every current text node.

Independent review confirmed the requested governance recovery is closed at the static layer. The terminal record preserves the explicit planned/unmapped debt rather than treating it as mapped, passed, or released.
